certification.name: Cellebrite Certified Mobile Examiner for Inseyets
certification.description: Capstone certification of the Cellebrite mobile forensics track, requiring active CCO and CCPA certifications and completion of the Cellebrite Advanced Smartphone Analysis (CASA) course. Candidates must score 80% or above on both a time-limited practical skills assessment of two device examinations and a proctored 75-question knowledge exam, within 45 days of enrollment.
certification.currency_note: Price on request (page says to log in to MyCellebrite for all costs); requires prior CCO, CCPA and the CASA course
